Usage: dohc <command> <verb> [arguments] [options]

Run dohc inside a workspace folder while the dohc app is open.

Commands:

commands.block:
links         Read and resolve document links.
                edges, connections, in, resolve

drawing       Read, create, and edit .excalidraw drawings.
                create, edit, read

notes         Convert this workspace's notes to the new format.
                convert

notices       Read this workspace's Notices.
                list

inbox         Capture notes and links into the workspace Inbox and triage
                them.
                add, archive, move, list

webhook       List and create incoming webhooks that add records to
                Collections.
                list, create

member-apps   List the apps you can open in this workspace, review Member
                apps, and share or copy your Personal apps.
                share, fork, promote, withdraw, sharing, list, inspect, source

sync          Stop syncing this workspace on this computer.
                stop

access        Read observed grants and request fresh Sharing inventories.
                refresh, object, sharing

share         Read copy details, and list and disconnect a link's agents.
                copy, agents, disconnect

members       List, invite, and remove the workspace's members, set what they
                can do, and manage the invite link.
                list, invite, remove, level, admin, member, let-back-in, link,
                group, folder, remove-folder-marker, end

document      Read, edit, and create live Markdown documents. List and start
                chats on tracked files. List, stop, and resume live documents,
                and recover edits the server refused.
                read, held, held-change, edit, create, set-fields, chats,
                comment, kept-edits, keep-outside-change, save-recovery-copy,

                outside-changes

collection    Query, read, and create Collection records, and check a

                query, read-record, create-record, validate

chat          Read and post in Groups and threads.
                groups, link, create-group, threads, watch, inbox, show, post,
                reply, retry, react, delete, grep, export, links, file-mentions

dataset       Create, change, and use transactional Collections.
                list, describe, types, sql, trace, history, historyRevision,
                prepareHistoryRestore, permissions, setGrant, setDefaults,
                removeGrant, lifecycle, archive, restore, deletePreview, delete,
                pendingAttempts, reconcileAttempt, cancelAttempt, cancelInvoke,
                export, prepareRecovery, claimRecovery, discardRecovery, upload,
                file, createForm, prepareRelationChoices, create, prepare,
                approve, discard, prepareMigration, askToApply,
                migrationPreviewPage, prepareSchemaChange, approveMigration,
                discardMigration, approval, confirmApproval, invoke

app           Approve, open, and share apps.
                verifyFrontend, createLink, personalFolder, listLocal,
                checkLocal, prepareLocal, stage, listStaged, approveStaged,
                discardStaged, launchLocal, list, prepare, approve, cancel,
                withdraw, revokeCollection, reviewReactivation, responses,
                undo-responses

file          Change workspace files.
                duplicate

history       Read History changes and undo deletes, moves, and renames.
                operation, undo, list, show, undo-agent-run, agent-run-plan

version       Read and change the workspace's versions and their open
                conflicts.
                list, compare, conflicts, create, switch, merge, update,
                archive, restore, resolve

automation    Press Button fields, read an automation's runs, try a failed run
                again, and check an automations.yaml file.
                list, host, use-server, switch, buttons, runs, run, retry,
                press, validate

account       Review and delete the server account the dohc app is connected
                to.
                deletePreview, delete

workspace     List the workspaces on this computer, and search pages,
                Collections, records, and chats across this workspace.
                info, search

Usage: dohc document <verb> [arguments] [options]

Read, edit, and create live Markdown documents. List and start chats on tracked files. List, stop, and resume live documents, and recover edits the server refused.

Verbs:
  read                  Read the current Markdown, including edits in an open
                        editor.
  held                  Show a change dohc held: the file's text and what saving
                        the change would write.
  held-change           Review, drop, or undo a held change on the owner's
                        computer.
  edit                  Replace matching text or append Markdown through the
                        live document.
  create                Create a Markdown document without overwriting an
                        existing file.
  set-fields            Set fields on a Collection record.
  chats                 List chats linked to a workspace file.
  comment               Start a chat linked to a file with its first message.
  kept-edits            List live documents whose edits the server refused or
                        has not accepted yet, and where dohc keeps those edits.
  keep-outside-change   Keep a live note's outside change as a copy and put the
                        note's text back in its file.
  save-recovery-copy    Save a document's kept edits next to it.
  retry-kept-edits      Send a document's kept edits to the server once more.
  stop-again            Stop live editing again for a document whose Stop kept
                        its edits.
  live                  List this workspace's live documents, with each one's
                        state and why.
  stop                  Stop live editing for a document, as Stop does in Live
                        documents.
  resume                Resume live editing for a document, as Resume does in
                        Live documents.
  outside-changes       List live notes whose file changed outside dohc.

Usage: dohc document edit <path> [-] [options]

Replace matching text or append Markdown through the live document.

Use - as the body to read it from stdin.
Use --text instead to supply the body as an argument. Each side allows at most
256 KiB of UTF-8.
Edits change the body, not frontmatter. Concurrent editing can prevent removing
blocks or changing their kind.
A pending warning means the edit is saved locally and the shared file update is
pending. Do not repeat it. Read again after other warnings or an unexplained
failure. Retry keys have the same limits as dohc_edit_document.

Usage: dohc document live [options]

List this workspace's live documents, with each one's state and why.

status is ready, preparing, paused, unavailable, or retired once live editing
stopped.
stopped is false on a retired document the server released without its owner's
Pause or Stop.
reason says why a document is not live. canResume is true when resume can start
it again.
document-unavailable: The file moved or was removed on this computer. Review it
in Live documents.
workspace-changed: The workspace changed while live editing ran. Review it in
Live documents.
session-host-refused: The server stopped live editing. The file and its history
are unchanged. Resume tries again.
session-host-diverged: The server's copy no longer matches the synced one.
Resume and Stop can't help. Contact the server's operator.
live-document-without-lineage: Live editing can't start until the document is
opened once in dohc. Open it, then Resume.
live-document-too-large: The note is larger than 256 KB, so it can't be edited
live, and Resume can't start it. Make it smaller or split it, then open it in
dohc and Resume.
live-edit-unadmitted: The server hasn't applied an edit. Resume tries again.
conflict-parent-withheld: A conflict in the file was resolved, so live editing
can't resume. Edits made in dohc may not reach people with the link. A copy can
go live, but it leaves out the row's kept edits. Save a recovery copy to keep
them. Then duplicate the file and open the copy in dohc. If only this file was
shared, share the copy too.
live-history-over-budget: The document's edit history is too long for the server
to check, so live editing can't start. Edits still sync, but people it is shared
with can't edit it live. Resume tries again now.
live-start-failing: The server can't start live editing and keeps trying.
failure.word is the server's reason, and failure.since is when it began. Resume
tries now.
note-format-off: The server turned off the newer note format this document uses.
Resume can't help. Contact the server's operator.
deferredStop is a Stop that waits for unsentEdits to reach the server. editable
says whether the document still takes edits.
quarantine is the recovery of edits the server refused, as kept-edits lists
them. stopping means a Stop waits for the server.
